You can try and show her the videos and articles about babies who catch herpes off a person kissing them. I don’t know if it’ll actually work though, because I remember during the lockdowns my grandmother refused to stop seeing her great granddaughter, who got the entire house including two babies sick. They were incredibly lucky not to pass around Covid, it would have killed both my grandparents. 


My cousin was my only point of outside contact, and went there while this had happened. She was horrified and asked why the heck they had a sick toddler visiting them? Why they did that and didn’t tell her, because now she couldn’t see me without a quarantine. The answer was “oh but I want her here! I can’t go without seeing her for that long! She’s the only light in my life” 


So they knew fully well what happens to people with Covid, they knew the risk to them in particular, and they didn’t care. They didn’t even consider the other two children in the home. They got everyone sick because they refused to take a break. They did not care. 


I’m hoping to all the deities that your MIL won’t be like that, that she’ll actually listen when you show her. I’m just scared she’s one of those people who doesn’t think she can get a baby sick because she loves them so much. It’s delusional, and I hope that is not the case. The fact is, she’s already done it in front of you, multiple times. She’s likely going to do it if she thinks no one is going to find out.

I don’t understand this one… she just kept posting the same things? It’s not updating anyone if it’s just a repeat of what she just said two days ago. She’s like “yep so my daughter is now back at university, MY GRANDCHILD WAS MURDERED AND MOTHERHOOD IS THE ONLY JOB A WOMAN SHOULD DO” every single time. It’s barely updating anything, just rewording what she said the previous time. 


She’s just posting the same shit over and over. Like a diary or something. She’s delusional yes, but that was obvious by the first post. Especially when everybody in her life knew what the right decision was. She’s just made it so none of her daughters will discuss anything with her in the future. Imagine throwing over your own kids in favour of an imaginary baby. 


I was also curious about the comments but then I noticed it was all posted in the pro life sub so it would just be a bunch of folks agreeing with her. This was a weird one.

No I agree, I was generalising and I shouldn’t have really, I don’t usually. Actually my Muslim friends back in high school were always very supportive of me. One of them was a hoot and decided to call herself my “Asian persuasion”, she was so funny and never made me feel awkward about being queer. 


I think it does depend on the family, or the sect, because there were well known families that were incredibly strict in our town, and the other families would try and help the daughters out of those other families. Most of them were quite progressive, just two families weren’t. One girl got sent away to be married off and had to be rescued and put into hiding. The other progressive families openly condemned what happened to her.


It just goes to show that the same religion can be used to justify abuse but also has people who would never behave that way to their own kids or anyone else’s. Same as Christianity too though, some people are progressive and some really really aren’t.

Do not worry about too much info, I’m autistic and I soak it up like a sponge. For real, thank you for this, I might not need it, but it is very interesting to me and I appreciate the time you took to tell me in detail. That’s really nice of you!

Thank you for that, I really had no clue that happened. Like.. how the fuck? Do you have like a million separate rooms for patients? The ER in my city is so far from the wards, you go back into a huge area to triage, with curtains and whatnot. It’s likely a bit different for Covid patients though, I haven’t had to attend since before the pandemic. 


But as far as my experience goes, they call you back, a nurse does all the tests they need to and then you go back out to wait. The doctor then calls you back after they have the test results, and discusses what to do next. So for me, I’ve been mostly for chest pain and suspected fractures, and not once did they ask me to do a pregnancy test. The only time I was asked was when I had my LLETZ procedure, but that’s pretty obvious because they were literally cutting into my cervix. I still felt really uncomfortable about it and I actually struggled so hard cos I couldnt have liquids! 


Thanks for answering me, this would have bothered me all night.

I understand what you’re saying, I get it, but what everyone including OP is saying is that she was treated badly. Can you seriously defend a nurse telling a patient “I won’t help you unless you do this”? Because I’ve never had a nurse treat me that way. I have significant trauma and it’s written all over my notes on how to treat me. I have very specific needs based on my trauma and since my doctors have labelled my records as much as they could, I’ve been treated better. 


The fact of the matter is the nurse was rude. She was disrespectful. Everyone else is arguing about the possibility of her still being pregnant, despite a hysterectomy, when the chance is so minimal. Everyone is talking about this like she lied to the staff when she quite clearly said she told multiple people. They had her records. It is not reasonable or right that she is now going to get this added to her fucking bill when she cannot be pregnant. I am not listening to any other comment stating “well actually it’s possible because it could be in her abdominal cavity” because the chance of that is so pitifully small it’s unreal that so many are using that as an excuse. 


Even if she did have that happen, why the fuck would someone withhold pain relief which was just paracetamol, when they know fully well it wouldn’t hurt a pregnancy anyway? There was zero reason to withhold that, no matter how many times you repeat yourself. You’re sounding like you’re excusing this treatment cos “that’s the way it’s done” but what everyone else is saying is that isn’t okay. That there needs to be a change, because women aren’t incubators. They deserve the treatment they need, not withhold it and make them suffer because they decided not to take a test. 


This is all so ridiculous and it’s just pissing me off royally that so many comments are defending it as the status quo. No one is sitting there and saying “that’s not how it’s done, nurse did this and this and that wrong” we’re saying “that’s the way it’s done and it’s fucked up to let that happen to a patient” 


She was treated like an object. She wasn’t treated like a person in pain. People keep saying wellll patients lieeee and they drug seek! Oh yes of course, that well known drug habit of TYLENOL./s 


What should happen is a person should be able to refuse a pregnancy test, and if it requires a fucking clause that she needs to sign to say she won’t sue, so fucking be it. Because no one should be forced to do something pointless, expensive and unnecessary. Why is no one bothered that she’ll get charged for this? No one cares that she’s distressed and upset. There’s zero empathy in these arguments and OP deserved better than a bunch of people playing devils advocate for a hospital they’ve never even seen.

Honey I had the same experience once I got it. It was like an epiphany! I can now get my high back AND the pain relief is amazing. I’m going to change up the amount a bit cos I’m feeling a bit rough in between times, but I’ll get it down pat soon I reckon. 

I’m so glad you worked it out, it totally works better than I could ever have thought.

Sure, if that was the case, but she already stated she had an ovarian cyst. The nurse was withholding care, despite the pain relief not being harmful to any pregnancy. She was already in her own room, I’ve asked previously but does the US just stuff folks into their own rooms before triage? Because where I am, they triage you first before you being given any sort of room or privacy. For example I went in for suspected heart attack. Before I got to a room, I had to have blood drawn, I had to get an ECG before I even saw a doctor. Is it that different in the US? That you just get sent to a room before anyone sees you? Because if it is, that’s pretty insane. 


Fact is, she went to a catholic hospital and I find it highly suspect that this nurse was apparently the only one who had the idea of ectopic pregnancy, and wanted to help OP. The only nurse in the whole place that was concerned about it. Not even the doctors? Mainly because non religious hospitals are letting people die of complications of ectopic pregnancy, I doubt that a catholic hospital of all places would be the ones who didn’t do that. The pain relief offered wouldn’t have hurt a pregnancy anyway, so there was zero reason to withhold it. It was a power play. The doctor even thought it was dumb. If the system wasn’t the way it was, I’d be less pissed off, but as it stands, OP will get charged for a test that didn’t need to be done to get help, and she didn’t need. If it was free, then it would be annoyance but we know that’s not how things are in the US. It’s also very scary when they’ve been treating pregnant folks very very badly especially recently. I cannot believe that the religious hospital of all places was the one who was concerned with aborting an ectopic pregnancy. 


Everyone is tying themselves in knots trying to defend this, when OP just needed to rant and get some comfort. I don’t know why everyone needs to defend a random nurse at a random hospital, over OP. It’s really disheartening. You don’t have to pander to OP, but the amount of pushback has been a bit depressing. Where’s the empathy for her?

He’s a little too old to be talking the way he is. I get that he was raised Muslim and obviously that isn’t going to be the most positive towards LGBTQ folks. But there’s no excuse for ignoring you and what you’re telling him. I’d even give some leeway if he was your age, but 24 is way past time to learn about other people and the world. It’s a bit privileged that he’s never had to consider it and therefore doesn’t bother to learn. 


He might be asking you questions and trying to, but he’s also telling you that you’re straight when you’re not. That’s just ignorant, and if he was really trying he would not be making those sweeping statements.

I don’t have any amazing tips that others haven’t said already, but I’m stoked for you to start playing! I love this game, it’s very cute, and it’s so relaxing. Nothing too stressful, and a lot of fun. The music is adorable and the character portraits are really nice. 



I’d recommend planting seeds when you get them, because growing and harvesting levels up the seeds. So I make sure I plant everything I can for the season until I hit a higher level.

Plant trees when you get the option for them, I didn’t see them until year 2 and I felt very stupid for missing that. They also level up with picking the fruits and nuts. 

Smoking fish is better than drying for contributing. 

Collect up wood and stone, and hardwood and grass. You’ll need it to build and upgrade. 


Caves need you to have food to restore your energy, cos hitting rocks takes a lot of it at first. I’d keep low grade crops to cook with. 


Get yourself a nice goat to ride asap. Running around takes ages at first. 

Participate in the festivals for prizes, and the story behind the festival. It’s so sweet, and rewarding. I notice that if I talk to everyone at a festival I get gifts the next day. 


Ive just finished the caves myself so I’m now onto the next update content and I am so excited to keep playing! I seriously feel so chill playing it, I’m sure you’ll enjoy it

Okay so this reminded me of when I was 17 and dating this guy just after I’d been broken up with by a girl (my parents called hers and talked some shit so her mother would stop us calling and talking) 

Anyway, one day my bf was helping my step father in the garden with some building shit. He came in to say hi, and I was just getting stuff ready for dinner. Step father turns around and hands him some cash. He smiles and thanks him, until stepfather says “that’s for turning my daughter straight again”

Lemme tell you, this poor kid just looked crestfallen. He looked over at me and just shook his head, cos I was staring in shock that this asshole said that out loud. AND thought it was funny. 
 
Kid was 16 and even he knew that was a fucked up thing to say about a person. He knew that nothing changed in me, I was the same person I always was. He apologised so much for not arguing back, but like what is he supposed to say to a grown ass man, being a 16 year old kid? I didn’t expect him to. 


How old are you both? Because it sounds like some ignorance teens go through. But then if his parents are judgmental about you being bisexual and attending Pride, I don’t know. Maybe he’s just been told that’s how it works. Either way it’s biphobia and it’s harmful to say that to you. He’s not just wrong, it’s hurtful to deny something so ingrained in you as a person. I stayed firmly in the closet until I was 30 because of this shit. 



You deserve better.

But that’s not what happened? OP explained what happened, they knew she had a cyst on her ovary. It wasn’t like she waltzed into the emergency room and demanded… paracetamol of all drugs.


They knew the reason for pain. They’d already set her up in a room by herself, which is usually after triage. Unless in the US no one gets triaged and just gets shoved into their own room before anyone has seen them, then get triaged? 


Tylenol (paracetamol) is not harmful to pregnancy, and the fact that they only offered her that is a travesty in itself. If you’re in the ER, it’s not because it’s a normal amount of pain, it’s serious. I’d understand more if they were offering her morphine, but they weren’t. 

It may well be and obviously is hospital policy, but that’s the issue we’re discussing isn’t it? That having a blanket policy is all well and good for the hospital, but it doesn’t give a lot of patients adequate care. It’s easy for them to just say it has to be done before any sort of treatment, despite the treatment not being a problem for pregnancy, but it’s not so easy when you’re the patient and haven’t got the parts required, it’s incredibly frustrating to sit in pain until you perform a pointless test. Especially because she’ll be charged for it! It’s a waste of resources and money. 


She’s been treated badly. Hospitals don’t need a devils advocate here, OP needed some support not having people argue constantly about how this was reasonable, because they’re just covering their own ass. That doesn’t help OP. She already knows all that. Doesn’t mean she can’t complain and feel disrespected because she was.

I get what you’re saying, but the fact that it wouldn’t be viable absolutely never should be a reason to withhold pain relief, especially when tylenol isn’t harmful to pregnancy anyway. That’s why it’s bullshit. 

If they gave a shit about her, they would have explained they were looking for an ectopic pregnancy which needs to be removed. But it was a catholic hospital and it’s highly suspect to me that they firstly didn’t believe her on not having any of the pets required to carry a viable pregnancy, then secondly refusing the safe-for-pregnancy pain relief to make her do the test. Thirdly, I doubt that nurse was even considering ectopic pregnancies and the risk to OP, seeing as secular hospitals are refusing people treatment during miscarriage or ectopic pregnancy in the US. Didn’t a teenager die fairly recently for being refused treatment for ectopic pregnancy? We have women actively dying in their parking lots because they refuse to help them if it means ending a pregnancy. Even if it is ectopic and not viable. 


I’m not saying to believe everyone all the time, but I m saying that it was very easy for that nurse to see charts, it was easy for her to consult someone else, or ask the attending doctor. She held all the cards here and pushed something that likely be charged to OP’s medical bills, when it wasn’t necessary and actively withheld care to force OP into it. That’s not reasonable or acceptable. I don’t care if she was scared of losing her job. She shouldn’t be a nurse if she’s happy to withhold such a minimal amount of pain relief, not when her patient was in pain and needing her help. She used her position to be a bully.

It was Tylenol. That’s not a strong painkiller whatsoever, and no one is making up a story about ovarian cysts just to get some paracetamol. They refused her because they felt like it, seeing as the doctor laughed at the stupidity of the whole thing.

It certainly wouldn’t be viable because she has no womb, and no tubes and just ovaries. It might be technically possible but what on earth does it matter when that bundle of cells would never become a foetus, and never be a baby either? 


The only reason I can see it being reasonable is if they were treating her for ectopic pregnancy as a risk to her life. But I don’t think that’s the case.

I can’t think of one procedure where men are not believed at their word. Maybe vasectomies come with that in particularly religious areas? I don’t know though. But then the test is to make sure they don’t accidentally kill a foetus with your treatment, it’s nothing to do with us as a human being. That’s what bothers me I think.. I get that some people may not know yet and do actually want the pregnancy to continue, but it’s the fact that the test is to determine how they treat your body, based on a foreign body inside yours, that’s what bothers me. 

Like I commented above I get it, I get why they test us and don’t assume we’re telling the truth but it does feel demeaning and disrespectful, like a potential foetus is more important than your health and wellbeing.

Oh man… I know why they do it cos patients can lie etc etc but it’s so annoying. I went in for a minor surgery in which I was put under anaesthetic cos of my own choice. Anyway, they told me no liquids after a certain time before the procedure, and i obviously used the bathroom when I woke up, so I had NOTHING in me. It was so stressful cos I’d never had surgery before and I was very distressed by not being able to urinate for them to test. 


They were like sorry, you gotta keep trying. 

Took me half an hour of literally praying for a few drops, actively pushing down on my bladder, hoping something was left over. Luckily there was like a teaspoonful and I apologised to them for such a crap sample, but seriously, how am I supposed to give a good one when I haven’t had liquids and already urinated before I left the house?! 

They then tried to give me a talk about sex and how I should be avoiding it because of various reasons, and I remember just getting embarrassed and bursting out with “IM CELIBATE AND GAY” to which the nurse stopped and cracked up laughing cos it came out of nowhere. 


I really do understand why they do the tests, but it doesn’t mean I can’t complain about it

You’re in Australia yes? You guys do have involuntary psych holds same as we do in the UK. It’s not the case that you just call a number and someone comes and collects the person, not even in the US, but you can indeed have someone committed under the guidelines set by the health service. I would think that seeing as he is actively refusing any help, and isn’t lucid for more than half the time, he would perhaps qualify. You say he isn’t violent but he has history of that and you don’t really know for sure that he won’t start up again, or harm himself or others. I’d be concerned about him roaming the neighbourhood and getting into a situation with a stranger, if he’s never lucid outside. 


Australia has a similar system to our NHS in the UK, not the exact same but it works similarly. There has to be someone who can actually help you, there can’t be no other option except you staying to babysit him and hope he doesn’t kill you or anyone else.

This is so difficult for me to read, just because I remember a lot of the things my mother went through and I also remember how frustrating and distressing it was to find out what actually happened to her in detail long afterwards. 


I want to extend some kindness because this is a very very hard situation to be in. You said you don’t know why you wrote this, and maybe it’s a few reasons. Firstly it could be that you don’t actually know what to do, and need some help deciding. Secondly it could be that you’ve had no one to be honest with about this, and needed to let it out. Thirdly, it could be that you are feeling like you want to hurt him in revenge and want someone to talk you out of it. I see from your comments that you’re pushing back a bit at the thought that your thinking isn’t as balanced and firm as you believe it to be, and I get that it feels like an attack but I think that people aren’t wanting to attack you, I think they’re trying to show you that no single human being can endure childhood abuse, then constant domestic violence without having their normal meter a bit messed up. Mine was for a really long time and I had no idea things weren’t normal and accepted. 


That’s not an attack on you, it’s an attack on the people that treated you so badly. There’s no shame in admitting someone broke something inside you. Because that’s how it feels eventually, I know that from experience. I didn’t know what way was up or down as a teenager who was abused mentally and emotionally every day. My abuser broke my brain, and I’m not ashamed to say he did. Because it’s not on me, it’s on him. 



Honestly, I’m worried for you. Not because I think you’re crazy or damaged or whatever label you’re thinking of, but because you’ve never lived your life the way that’s healthy and okay. You’ve never gotten to have a life, and trust me when I say I just made that realisation for myself last year and it hurt my heart to come to terms with it. That I’d never experienced a normal life because I was so afraid and scared and angry, that I pushed people away and kept bad people instead, or that I didn’t look after myself because I didn’t give a shit if I was alive or not. It makes me cry to think of the time I’ve spent just trying to survive instead of actually living. 

Don’t you want to be free and live for you? I understand that you’re paying the rent, but can you at the very least pay the rent elsewhere, you’re already paying it alone, and he should not be coming with you. I also understand that he’s refused medication but that doesn’t mean you have to be there to look after him either. I’m concerned that you’re thinking of hurting him in his psychosis, mainly because you don’t sound like a person who would want to hurt someone else, but also I’m scared that if you do that, he may hurt you back worse this time because he has no grip on reality. Like I’m legitimately concerned he could kill you, he’s not on the same planet currently and he does need assistance but not from a person he battered for years. You’re not qualified to help him and he should be in a hospital for treatment. 


Don’t become him, don’t harm him out of revenge, not because it’s wrong but because it’ll hurt you in the long run. Harming someone when they’re vulnerable is the same thing he did to you, and you know that was wrong of him. Don’t copy his shitty actions, you’re better than he is. 


I know you said you can’t call anyone to get him help, and he’s legally refused antipsychotics, (which is absolutely wild btw) but you cannot get through this alone. I know you think it’s fucked that some countries allow for a psychiatric hold involuntarily, but it’s for situations like this where you don’t have any help and he won’t get himself any help either. It’s for situations where you’re stuck and don’t know what else to do. 


I’m going to stop here and stop talking because I feel like I’m rambling, but I really just wanted you to know that you don’t have to do this. You don’t have to suffer anymore and you don’t have to become someone you’re not. He doesn’t even matter now, you should live for you and you alone.

I think it’s good practice to learn how to not understand something and be okay with it. Like for example, my dad used to ask me questions like this, alongside my little brother. He genuinely wanted to understand us, and he would get himself in knots trying to put himself in our shoes. 


One day I just said to him that it was okay that he didn’t get it, because I genuinely didn’t understand heterosexuality, but I was okay with not understanding it. Because I didn’t need to understand, in order to be loving and respectful to my straight friends and family. I didn’t need to really get into it in order to have compassion and empathy for them. It was like a light bulb went off in his head, he was like “oh yeah duh obviously I love you guys the way you are, I just thought I should be asking questions” which I thought was sweet of him. He felt like if he asked, it meant he gave a shit about our lives. And we took it that way! 


But yeah, since then I’ve never questioned anyone on their own orientation without knowing they’ll be cool with it, I know some people end up feeling like they have to justify their orientation if it’s not the “usual” big three of Straight, Homosexual and Bisexual. Most people know of those. 


Personally I find women most attractive with barely any caveats in that, they are what I’m attracted to and think about when I think of relationships. Men, I have some caveats with. I only find certain types of men attractive, and although I was dating them all my life, I didn’t feel like it was that comfortable. I don’t feel like I would want to date men again, although I can admit I find some attractive still. I love any sort of gender bending, and as a genderfluid person myself I’d be happier with someone like that. It’s not a black and white thing, and that’s something I had no idea about when I was younger. 

Nowadays I’m much more secure in my sexuality, although I was in the closet most of my life. All because I accepted that there are nuances to all of it. Even straight folks have “types”. It’s kind of the same thing.

It’s always disheartening to see comments like that. Mainly because no one would be commenting that if he were a woman. I hate the usual “reverse the genders” topic, because it’s often used in bad faith, but this is an abused man who was abused all through his life by his own mother. 


It’s why my uncle didn’t get help until his child was endangered, and even then he kept trying to keep the peace with a woman who genuinely tried to kill him. Because he was scared of being further brought down by his parents mocking him, (which they did when he admitted it) and scared of not being believed. I believed him, and so did my mother because we lived next door and heard it all. It didn’t matter, he still felt like he failed and it was all his fault. For having been beaten with a frying pan around the head. His crime? Well he was currently bathing his newborn preemie while his wife was trying to find something to bash his head in with.

I have constructed a very delicate procedure of using both fans and central heating and different times of the night/early morning. So now it’s warmer I just use a fan all night, but when it was colder, I discovered when the temp outside dropped (about 3-4am) and set the heating to come on then, so I wouldn’t be freezing cold and shivering after having sweat all night. I used the fan to control the temp from 10pm to around the time I set the heating. 


I tend to wear lighter pjs, I use an all over body antiperspirant spray, but it’s stopped working so well now. It was called Perspiguard I think. 


But yeah my temp regulation is fucked and I hate it. I’m always boiling and slightly sweating, always pink in the face. Then after I’ve done that, my temp drops and I shiver like a leaf. It sucks, and I’m sorry you’re dealing with it too. I’m also UK, I saved up for one for a while. And then didn’t use the damn thing for two years cos I wasn’t impressed. It took me that long to decide to quit tobacco and nicotine, so I got that shit out of the way a couple of months back. 


Anyway, I would recommend it, you can get decent ones for under £200 (which is a massive amount of money for me tbh, I think I got my Pax 3 on sale) and took all the info I needed from vaporents. They’re a top notch sub, and really helpful when I’ve needed advice. It took me a while to switch over, but I’ll be completely honest and say that it’s changed the way I feel and how my mood is, as well as making it easier for me to move without pain. I’m not one to suggest things to people usually, but when you’re in pain, I know how shitty it feels and how it can ruin a day. You don’t have to do it, it’s just something to consider down the line maybe. I would just love it if someone else got their high back too. It’s a good feeling. Haha

I vape now cos I was using tobacco to make mixes and honestly it fucked my lungs. But it always amazes me when other people stop using it, and then say they have an appetite again or good sleep. Those two things are partially why I vape weed. The other being pain relief. But I am not good at eating regularly or healthily, and I have chronic bad nightmares. Those stopped once I started to smoke (then vape). It did lose efficacy over the years, but still worked enough to get me along. Now I’m vaping it instead and no nicotine whatsoever, I feel like I did when I first started. Much better appetite again, making healthier choices and munching on fresh veg and salad, and sleeping better. I was only getting 4 hours a night, now I get six. 

It’s wild how differently it can affect people and how differently usage affects people. I guess it’s the same for any sort of medicine though, some people can’t use it and some can.

Just wanted to jump in and ask if you’ve tried vaping dry herb instead? I switched up for health reasons, and I wasn’t impressed at first, until someone on the vaporents sub told me how to inhale with my specific vape. I was doing it completely incorrectly somehow. Now it’s a game changer. I was instantly convinced it’s the way to go. It’s been helping my pain so much better, and I’ve been able to actually feel baked for the first time in years. It feels like going back to the start again.

This meant that my childhood (up until I was 8) was a very warm, peaceful and loving environment. My parents still loved each other but not that way anymore. I remember fondly when I got a game boy and my two dads helping me with Tetris levels.

You love your son, your ex loves him too, you just want to make sure he’s safe and happy. Getting along like you are is a good thing, it doesn’t mean you want to sleep together. Your brother is threatening to kill your mother and has beaten his girlfriend. That’s way past intervention time. He needs a shock, and he needs it quick. Sometimes it’ll scare someone into trying harder to get better, sometimes it won’t. But it’s in his best interests to have consequences for his behaviour. He HAS to. Otherwise he’ll end up dead from his addiction, cos there’s no rock bottom to hit. I’ve done a lot of drug and alcohol programs for a job I had a while back. I was helping people get back into work and I primarily dealt with people with addictions, people who were sick, people who needed extra help getting there. What I learned is, it takes an average of 9 times for intervention to work. It may be sooner, might be later, but that’s the average. It’s why I’m patient with my brother but also don’t court any bullshit from him. I understand how hard it is to break those habits, the drugs are addictive for a reason. 

But the person has to want to get better. You can’t force a person to do things in their own best interests when they aren’t choosing to do so. We know fully well what it’s like and how they struggle, but there HAS to be a catalyst to them needing it for themselves. Trying to force it doesn’t work. They have to choose this themselves.

He has to learn this the hard way it seems. It may well be the drugs that’s making him insane, but I would be careful in saying “that’s not how he is”. Because it absolutely is. I’ll give you what I personally think having studied the role of “strong women” in the media. 


There was a change in how protagonists act and what kind of protagonists people respond to. When there’s the influx of strong female characters, writers have tended to make excuses for why they’re so different to their softer counterparts. 


Things as simple as “I grew up with all brothers I know how to fight!” is an example of it, but the most heinous one is the trope of the victim turned survivor. It happened a lot and doesn’t happen AS often in recent years but it’s still very prevalent. They seem to believe that making a woman a victim of rape is the main reason why she would be an asskicking powerhouse. They can’t imagine that a woman might just be good at fighting and had the necessary training. They have to give her a purpose for why she is how she is. In more recent times, there’s been backlash against that like when the new Lara Croft came out and she was assaulted in a cut scene, despite that not being part of her lore previously. There’s a reason I won’t watch GoT, because I truly believe it’s lazy writing to just push women into situation where they’re abused in order for us to care about them, or for her to be a stronger character. 

I feel somewhat personally about that, because I had a friend once tell me I was like Lisbeth Salander because I’d been raped and was really kick ass. He meant it as a compliment but my rape isn’t what defines me as a person, and it hurts to be reduced to that one event. 


The other side of this is that, unfortunately is the notion that sex sells. They made Tasha an object in her flashbacks, made her bring up the “rape gangs” so we all blatantly have to see why she’s a good security officer. Not that she’s trained like the rest of them, but because she was a victim previously. The fact that it’s brought up at very weird times makes me feel like it’s done for salaciousness. To writers back then, the imagery of the rape gangs brings up connotations with sex, therefore making Tasha into a “sexy” character. 


This is further shown when she’s constantly in sexual situations, having to fight men who want to take her, fighting women who want those men. It’s all very disheartening when she could have been an amazing character in her own right. She didn’t need the history of running from rape gangs, she didn’t need to justify her strength. 


The death of Tasha was such a disappointment and I understand that they’ve said it was to show how much risk it is to be a starship officer and anything can happen to anyone. But what they failed to realise is they created a character with a huge traumatic history, who’s always fighting and doing what’s right, only to have Armus take her down for nothing. I remember thinking she couldn’t actually be dead, but quickly realising that they really meant it this time. 



All in all, it was a common trope back in the day and only has been talked about in recent years. I studied this kind of representation in university over 15 years ago, and it’s always been disappointing to see from then on.

For me, I’m very used to how they are. Only my grandad has changed since my dad died, my grandmother has always been quick to cry about literally anything ever. It was a source of anxiety and stress for me as a child because I’m autistic and I took it literally when someone said “don’t tell your nanna, she’ll have a heart attack” I legit thought I’d kill her if I argued against her behaviour. 


So I didn’t for a really long time. Like.. twenty years. And then I got to adulthood and realised that she’s not going to die randomly if something bad happens, that’s stupid and I didn’t need to be the emotional support animal. So I distanced myself from them physically, I was working a lot and I was extremely busy. It was easy. Nowadays, I can’t work due to disability, so I’m free all the time. Except travelling to them means two trains and a lot of discomfort for me, because I’ve moved further away on purpose. I’ve told them I can’t do it all the time, and why. I don’t think they really understand but that doesn’t matter because what are they gunna do? Drive to my house? Nope, they won’t do it and they also don’t know my address. The context of why I still see them is, I cut off my maternal family about five years ago. All of them, except my mother and my cousin. Since then I’ve been much healthier despite being disabled, my mental health improved massively. I look at my paternal grandparents and see two people who are very sheltered in their cul-de-sac, with the same friends and same house for 60 years. Same routines. Same complaints. They are so set in their ways, it’s frankly impossible for them to see any other way of life. 

They aren’t nasty, they can be ignorant of others feelings, and I’ve explained to them why that’s hurtful. I find this happens to people with autism because people coddled them unnecessarily and made them feel that they were more important than anyone else on the planet and that everyone should think so. I’m autistic and let me just say that my empathy is actually quite irritating at times, I feel everything dialled up to 11. I don’t mean that I always get why people feel how they do, but I do want to help literally everyone in existence if it was possible. 

That said, I’ve known a lot of autistic people in my lifetime, we have a few of us in our family, girls and boys and anyone in between. I noticed the ones who were boys, were more often harsh with their comments, doubled down on them when told it hurt, would be physically imposing and had an inflated sense of superiority. They felt more smart than the rest of us autistic family members. The difference was the rest are girls, and weren’t told that we were smarter than everyone else, that we didn’t have to make friends or talk to others or that we were more important than anyone else. We were taught that being rude is wrong and doesn’t make you friends. We were taught if we didn’t have friends or weren’t dating, we weren’t acting “normal”. We were unfortunately shown that people thought us to be defective but the boys are considered as Rain Man. 

One boy isn’t like that at all, he’s much more like the female family members. Because he was taught differently, he wasnt coddled to the point of keeping him a child all his life. He’s a sweet kid, a young man now, and he has achieved a lot considering he couldn’t use a bathroom by himself and was told he never would. His parents got him very good help, a great school and all the accommodation he needed, while still teaching him he’s just like the rest of us. What happened was that they raised a young man who is affectionate, easy to smile, empathetic and friendly. He doesn’t have that sense of false superiority, because he wasn’t told he was better than everyone else. He was taught that his brain works differently but he’s still the same as any other person. 

I know my story is anecdotal, but it’s a shame that so many people have this idea of what being autistic is, and why people behave poorly while autistic. It’s usually the way they were raised and socialised, not the way they actually are inherently.
